src: columns of the 3x3 maroon/blue marker on the top edge; the bottom cell of each column is the control pixel
path: vertical drop in each marker column; blue-ended columns stop above the first grey obstacle below, while maroon-ended runs pass through to the bottom with a one-column right slide from a clear grey ledge
trajectory: copy each three-pixel marker column intact; contiguous maroon-ended columns are tested as one run for the slide
dst: settled positions on the same canvas after erasing the top marker
transform: if a maroon-ended drop lands through a grey bar on the bottom edge, clear the rest of the marker-width gap in that bar; leave other grey obstacles fixed
